anchors.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper proposes MEG-BIDS, an extension of the BIDS standard to organize and share MEG data, making it a technical specification/methodology for data structure, not a paper describing the NOD-MEG dataset itself.

metadata.methods_description: MEG and EEG data were collected from subjects passively viewing naturalistic object images from ImageNet. Raw data are provided in BIDS format with preprocessing performed using MNE (version 1.7.1). Preprocessed data and epoch data are available in derivatives directories. Trial-level metadata including stimulus category information and subject responses are documented in detailed events files.
